scoped_blockers.title: Windows text-mode overlay generation corrupts continuation lines
scoped_blockers.cause: Raw CRLF text is written through Windows write_text, producing CRCRLF. The pre-write AST parse does not test the written bytes.
scoped_blockers.minimal_fix: Replace output.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8') with output.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8')); regenerate a separate isolated overlay and its existing manifest, preserving this failed version.
scoped_blockers.repair_status: NOT_APPLIED. All three exact in-memory write_bytes candidates parse under Python 3.7.6; repaired on-disk artifacts and their review remain pending.
